sentences.en: The prominent poet attempted to commit suicide in his study.
sentences.zh: 这位著名的诗人试图在他的书房里自杀。

sentences.en: The poet and novelist were both present at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 那位诗人和小说家都出席了会议。

sentences.en: Shakespeare is the greatest poet that England has ever produced.
sentences.zh: 莎士比亚是英国历史上最伟大的诗人。

senses.zh: 诗人,空想家,古典芭蕾舞大师
